# mergegateway_project_dlp_settings (Resource)

Overrides the organization's DLP (data loss prevention) rules for one project, entity type by entity type. A project has one set of DLP settings: creating this resource replaces any override the project already has, and destroying it resets the project to the organization's rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergegateway_project" "support_bot" {
  name = "Support bot"
}

# Entity types are the entity_type values that GET
# /v1/projects/{project_id}/dlp-settings lists.
#
# Redact email addresses and block credit card numbers in this project, and
# stop detecting phone numbers. Every other entity type follows the
# organization's DLP rules.
resource "mergegateway_project_dlp_settings" "support_bot" {
  project_id = mergegateway_project.support_bot.id

  override = {
    EMAIL_ADDRESS = { enabled = true, action = "redact" }
    CREDIT_CARD   = { action = "block" }
    PHONE_NUMBER  = { enabled = false }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `override` (Attributes Map) The project's overrides, keyed by entity type (the `entity_type` values that `GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/dlp-settings` lists). Each one sets `enabled`, `action` or both. Entity types left out follow the organization's rules; removing one from the map removes its override. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--override))
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project. Changing it moves the override to another project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project's ID, the same as `project_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `override`

Optional:

- `action` (String) What happens when the entity type is detected: `log`, `redact` or `block`. Leave it out to follow the organization.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the entity type is detected in this project. Leave it out to follow the organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project's DLP settings by the project's ID.
terraform import mergegateway_project_dlp_settings.support_bot 6f1c1f5e-8a8b-4c43-9a0e-3f0f6d0c8b11
```
